clips.title: The story
paras: A courier carries Sample of Zanzil's Altered Mixture across the sea to Tarren Mill. The brew came from the witch doctor Zanzil and leaves its carrier weakened. Serge Hinott may find a cure and uncover the poison's workings.

An operative carries the mixture after infiltrating the Venture Company's tower near the Sludge Fen in the Barrens. The sample came from a cache in Gallywix's lockbox, and Zanzil's brew has left the agent afflicted. Shenthul sends the stricken operative across the Great Sea with the sample. At Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills, apothecary Serge Hinott has the rare skill to isolate the toxin and learn its components.
